name: Jan

knownPaths.description: Jan's data folder. Most of the space here is the models it downloaded — the multi-gigabyte files behind each assistant — together with your conversations and settings. Deleting a model means downloading it again; deleting the conversations is not recoverable.
Jan's model folder, for older installations that keep models in the home directory rather than in Application Support. Every file here is a downloaded model.
Jan's older home-directory data folder, holding conversations and settings as well as anything under jan/models.

description: Jan — an offline chat application that runs models on the Mac and keeps your conversations on disk.
